firstPlayerRule: The player with the most viewings of The Martian chooses a turn-order space first. After everyone chooses, the lowest occupied numbered space takes the first Colonization turn.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Turn-order spaces are chosen clockwise from that initial chooser. The first chooser is not necessarily first to take a Colonization action.
The First Colonists variant assigns spaces using randomly dealt tiles instead of letting players choose their spaces.
Solo setup assigns Lacerda’s space with a random First Colonists tile, then lets you choose your own space or randomize it.
